## Module Overview

### Module summary

A module group to run the `scfm` suite of modules found at <https://github.com/PredictiveEcology/scfm>:

- `ageModule` (optional)
- `scfmDataPrep`
- `scfmEscape`
- `scfmIgnition`
- `scfmSpread`

### Module parameters, inputs and outputs

See documentation for individual modules.
